rows.en: There's another one over here! Hey, you! Are you all right?
Wh-what are you doing?
Whoa-whoa-whoa, this isn't what I heard! I didn't know Ultra Garrison officers were this violent!
Hold on a second! There's something strange about these people.
What!? Mr. Hongo, you can't mean…? Well… I guess there's no choice.
Gwah!
All right, we managed to knock them out… But why would the Ultra Garrison attack us?

…!?

This "feeling"…? Something nasty is coming closer!
…!? A Shocker monster…
Mr. Hongo! Let's fight!!
Curse you, Shocker! What are you plotting this time?
Curse you, Shocker! What are you plotting this time?

Eh, eh, eh… Traitor Takeshi Hongo! No, Kamen Rider!!

I'll tell you, as a parting gift to take to the grave. With my mind-control virus, I will manipulate humans as I please and place them under Shocker's rule!

As an experiment, I'll start by turning every human in this city into a puppet! Eh, eiiiiii!!
So that's the horrible scheme you were plotting!?
So that's the horrible scheme you were plotting!?
Eh, eh, eh… Unless you defeat me, there's no way to save the ones infected with the virus!
You don't need to tell me! I'll defeat you and examine every inch of your body!!
You don't need to tell me! I'll defeat you and examine every inch of your body!!
Curses, was I too late!? How dare you do that to Bat Man… Grr, finish them off!
Captain…! Pointer's over there!
What!?
That's… Soga and Furuhashi, isn't it!?
…!? And who are you?
I'm Takeshi Hongo. These are my companions.
I'm Kiriyama, captain of the Ultra Garrison. I'd like you to tell me what on earth happened here.

All right… But before that, these two have been hit by a terrible virus.

It should be possible to make a vaccine from the claws on Bat Man's wings. Biochemistry is my specialty… Please, let me make it first.
Very well, understood! Come with us to the TDF Far East Base.
Ultra Garrison captain Kiriyama returned to the Far East Base with Takeshi Hongo. Hongo directed the TDF's scientists and produced the vaccine.
Thanks to the vaccine Hongo created, Officers Furuhashi and Soga came back to their senses. Captain Kiriyama asked Hongo for an outline of the incident.
Hongo told Kiriyama about the existence of Shocker, its terrifying ambitions… and the secret of his own body!
Taking the situation seriously, Captain Kiriyama consulted Director Yamaoka and the staff officers beneath him.
Hongo…
Well, Captain Kiriyama? Are the brass going to get serious about defeating Shocker?

Hongo, I'll give you the conclusion first…

I'm sorry… but the TDF cannot intervene in your battle.

Why not!?

Captain Kiriyama, you saw what happened to Officer Furuhashi and the others, didn't you?

Is the TDF going to ignore an organization with such terrifying scientific power?

Hear me out.

We are only permitted to use our power against the forces of "extraterrestrial life-forms."

But this Shocker organization, demonic as its power may be, is still made up of life-forms from Earth…

We are never permitted to turn our guns on our fellow humans… even if they are cyborgs.
So that's the TDF's position…

However… it's also true that we feel a sense of crisis about this organization called Shocker.

And I can't rule out that measures against cyborgs could move the council in the future. So…

We've decided to provide you with several Defense Officers who can operate current-issue weapons, along with whatever information and funds you need.

We want you to keep fighting as a separate anti-Shocker unit.
What!?

To start with… I'll have someone from the FBI who knows a great deal about Shocker dispatched to you.

But… there's no question this will be a hard fight. Can you still do it?

Captain Kiriyama…

From the day my body was modified, I swore I would defeat Shocker, no matter how hard and long the road!
Mm… That's the spirit, Hongo. If anything comes up, don't hesitate to tell me…
Yes, sir…
Eiiiiii!! Curse you, you'll pay for this!
Gyaaah!!
"Ugh… O-Oyassan…"

Ha ha ha… Takeshi Hongo! Take this injection from my Poison Needle!

I'm looking forward to paralyzing you and making you a complete cyborg!
Defeat Executive Monster Bat Man!
Defeat Executive Monster Bee Woman and all Shocker Combatants!
All enemies destroyed
All allies are destroyed
Takeshi Hongo is defeated
All allies destroyed
<c3>Hayato Ichimonji</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Hayato Ichimonji</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
Leader! The cyborg surgery on Scorpion Man… is complete!

Mm… Scorpion Man, created by Shocker's proud scientists…

With his completion, Japan belongs to us, Shocker!

Scorpion Man… Defeat him! Defeat Takeshi Hongo!
Shhh, shhh, shhh, shhh… Takeshi Hongo… Killing that man is my reason for living.
Having succeeded in gaining the TDF's cooperation, Takeshi Hongo and the other warriors of justice were joined by yet another new comrade. His name was Kazuya Taki…
Sent from the FBI at Captain Kiriyama's request, investigator Kazuya Taki was an information-gathering specialist who had been pursuing the mysterious organization Shocker all along.

What are you fools so jumpy about?

As long as I, Scorpion Man, am here, this Shocker Japan Branch is…
There's been an order from the Leader…
From the Leader?
Yes, sir… They say Colonel Zol has been dispatched as Supreme Commander of the Japan Branch.

Colonel Zol!?

The Colonel Zol said to hold the greatest real power in Shocker!?
Gwah…
Eeee!!
Your uniform is in disarray! Slackness in dress is proof of slackness in spirit! I will never tolerate slackness!!
Eeee!!
C-Colonel Zol!?
Colonel Zol, great executive of our Shocker!

Leader! Planting our own people among the enemy…

With this method, I crushed every last anti-Shocker force in the Middle East!

Now that I have come to Japan… I will without fail eliminate Shocker's enemy, Kamen Rider.

Heh heh heh… I have high expectations of you, Colonel Zol!

But… by what means do you intend to eliminate Kamen Rider and his allies?

I have already worked out the countermeasure.

Kamen Rider is certainly a formidable enemy with terrifying hidden power… But Leader, have you not forgotten something?
What do you mean, Colonel Zol?

That it was we, Shocker, who made that Takeshi Hongo a cyborg.

You understand now, I trust? Since we created Kamen Rider, we can likewise create another Kamen Rider.

And we should be able to create him as a ruthless cyborg sworn in loyalty to us, Shocker.
A truly intriguing plan. Create a new cyborg, a Kamen Rider, and eliminate Kamen Rider and his allies!
Heh heh heh…

An emergency message just came in from FBI Central!

Colonel Zol, Shocker's supreme commander, whom we've long had marked, has left the Middle East Shocker Branch for the Japan Branch! Exercise extreme caution…

…And that's that!
